files.html:
0.1.6 Change Log

Changed

  • Redesigned the Battle Rules editor into a clear three-panel workspace.
  • Merged Level Rules into Battle Setup.
  • Changed item rule editing to checkbox selection with search and multi-mod filters.

Added

  • Added common rules and per-round rule overrides.
  • Added Singles, Doubles, Triples, and Lead Duel battle formats.
  • Added controls for levels, battle items, held items, Legendary Pokemon, battle gimmicks, and lead selection.

Fixed

  • Fixed battle item restrictions for bag items, revives, and capture items.
  • Fixed rule state when switching rounds or returning to common rules.
  • Fixed editor navigation, layout overlap, and localized text display.
